notes: **Quick Pick** (⌃⌥C) now uses the macOS magnifier: your screen stays live, click picks, Esc cancels. It needs no Screen Recording permission, so picking works the moment you install ColorPickr. A small card by the cursor shows what you picked, its name in plain words and the format it was copied in.
**Precision Pick** (⌃⌥⇧C) is the frozen-screen picker, for 3×3 and 5×5 averages, pixel nudging and dragging an area into a palette.
Screen Recording permission is now optional. It powers Precision Pick, Screen Check and the color vision simulation.
